feature.sky_veil.description: Adds realistic cloud shadows that move across the landscape, creating dynamic lighting changes as clouds pass overhead, enhancing atmospheric immersion.
feature.sky_veil.key_feature_1: Dynamic cloud shadow projection on terrain and objects
feature.sky_veil.key_feature_2: Configurable shadow opacity for artistic control
feature.sky_veil.key_feature_3: Real-time shadow movement synchronized with cloud motion
feature.sky_veil.key_feature_4: Cubemap-based shadow calculation for accurate projection
feature.sky_veil.name: Sky Veil
feature.sky_veil.opacity_tooltip: Higher values make cloud shadows darker.
feature.world_probes.creator_info: You must enable creator mode by adding the shader define CREATOR
feature.world_probes.description: Provides real-time environment mapping and reflections by generating dynamic cube maps that capture the surrounding environment, enabling realistic reflections on surfaces.
feature.world_probes.enable_ssr_tooltip: Master switch for screen-space reflections on water. Water Optics controls the enhanced trace quality.
feature.world_probes.key_feature_1: Real-time environment capture for realistic reflections
feature.world_probes.key_feature_2: Dynamic cube map generation based on camera position
feature.world_probes.key_feature_3: Enhanced water reflections with environmental details
feature.world_probes.key_feature_4: Optimized cubemap inference and irradiance calculation
feature.world_probes.name: World Probes
feature.atmosphere.apply_vanilla_fade_to: Applies vanilla fade brightness to exponential height fog.
feature.atmosphere.dir_inscattering_anis:
Controls the asymmetry of inscattering via the Henyey-Greenstein phase function.
Positive values produce forward scattering (glow around sun).
Zero is isotropic. Negative values produce back scattering.
feature.atmosphere.disable_vanilla_fog_t: Disables the vanilla fog entirely. Only exponential height fog will be applied.
feature.atmosphere.sample_jitter_multipl:
Matches UE's r.VolumetricFog.LightScatteringSampleJitterMultiplier.
Adds per-voxel random offset on top of the Halton sequence.
0 = UE default; nonzero values need stronger temporal filtering.
feature.atmosphere.upsample_jitter_multi:
Matches UE's r.VolumetricFog.UpsampleJitterMultiplier.
Jitters the final 3D fog lookup in screen space to hide
low-resolution froxel pixelization. 0 = UE default.
feature.exponential_height_fog.descripti: Atmosphere adds a realistic fog effect that increases in density with height, enhancing atmospheric depth and immersion in the game environment.
feature.exponential_height_fog.name: Atmosphere
feature.material_layers.description:
Material Layers adds advanced material effects including parallax occlusion mapping and complex material blending.
This feature enhances surface detail and depth perception for more realistic textures.
feature.material_layers.enable_complex_m: Enables support for the Complex Material specification which makes use of the environment mask. This includes parallax, as well as more realistic metals and specular reflections. May lead to some warped textures on modded content which have an invalid alpha channel in their environment mask.
feature.material_layers.enable_height_bl: Enables landscape texture blending based on parallax.
feature.material_layers.enable_legacy_te: Enables terrain parallax using the alpha channel of each landscape texture. Therefore, all landscape textures must support parallax for this effect to work properly.
feature.material_layers.enable_parallax_: Enables parallax on standard meshes made for parallax.
Enables a fix reducing parallax scale on curved and smooth normal triangles.
feature.material_layers.enable_shadows_t: Enables cheap soft shadows when using parallax. This applies to all directional and point lights.
feature.material_layers.name: Material Layers
feature.thin_surface.blend_weight_toolti: Control the blend weight of the effect applied to the final result.
feature.thin_surface.default_material_mo:
Anisotropic translucency will adjust the opacity based on your view angle to the translucent surface.
  - Disabled: No anisotropic translucency, flat alpha.
  - Rim Edge: Naive rim light effect with no physics model, the edge of the geometry is always opaque even its full transparent.
  - Isotropic Fabric: Imaginary fabric weaved from threads in one direction, respect normal map, also works well for layer of glass panels.
  - Anisotropic Fabric: Common fabric weaved from tangent and birnormal direction, ignores normal map.
feature.thin_surface.description:
Thin Surface provides realistic rendering of thin fabric and other translucent materials.
This feature supports multiple material models for different types of translucent surfaces.
feature.thin_surface.key_feature_1: Multiple translucency material models (rim edge, isotropic/anisotropic fabric)
feature.thin_surface.key_feature_2: Realistic fabric translucency with directional light transmission
feature.thin_surface.key_feature_3: Per-material override support via NIF extra data
feature.thin_surface.name: Thin Surface
feature.thin_surface.skinned_mesh_only_t: Control if this effect should only apply to skinned mesh. Check this option if you are seeing undesired effects on random objects.
feature.thin_surface.softness_tooltip: Control the softness of the alpha increase, increase the softness reduce the increased amount of alpha.
feature.thin_surface.transparency_increa: Translucent material will make the material more opaque on average, which could be different from the intent. Reduce the alpha to counter this effect and increase the dynamic range of the output.
feature.ground_response.description: Enables dynamic grass interactions where grass bends and moves in response to actors walking through it, creating more immersive environmental reactions.
feature.ground_response.key_feature_1: Real-time grass deformation from actor movement
feature.ground_response.key_feature_2: Collision detection for up to 256 simultaneous interactions
feature.ground_response.key_feature_3: Dynamic tracking of actor positions for grass response
feature.ground_response.key_feature_5: Seamless integration with existing grass rendering
feature.ground_response.name: Ground Response
feature.actor_surface_effects.name: Actor Surface Effects
feature.foliage_dynamics.brightness_tool: Darkens the grass textures to look better with the new lighting
feature.foliage_dynamics.description:
Foliage Dynamics enhances grass rendering with improved lighting, specularity, and subsurface scattering.
This makes grass appear more natural and responsive to lighting conditions.
feature.foliage_dynamics.detection_thres: Threshold for detecting complex grass textures. Lower values are more strict.
feature.foliage_dynamics.name: Foliage Dynamics
feature.foliage_dynamics.override_comple: Override brightness authored in complex grass meshes when it does not account for PIXL's additional light sources.
feature.foliage_dynamics.sss_tooltip: Tissue Diffusion (SSS) amount. Soft lighting controls how evenly lit an object is. Back lighting illuminates the back face of an object. Combined to model the transport of light through the surface.
feature.strand_shading.description: Provides better hair shading with realistic specular highlights and tangent-based light interaction for more lifelike hair appearance.
feature.strand_shading.enable_self_shado:
Enables screen-space self-shadowing for hair.
Marschner hair model might have overly bright transmission without self-shadowing.
feature.strand_shading.enable_tangent_sh:
Enables the use of a tangent shift texture to vary specular highlights across hair strands.
Result may vary based on the hair model used.
feature.strand_shading.glossiness_toolti:
Controls the glossiness of the hair.
Glossiness in Kajiya-Kay mode maps to the specular exponent.
In Marschner mode, it controls the roughness of the hair surface.
feature.strand_shading.hair_mode_tooltip:
Select the hair shading model to use.
Kajiya-Kay is an empirical model that simulates hair specular highlights.
Marschner is a more physically-based model that simulates hair light interaction.
Both models are anisotropic and support tangent-based shading.
Without self-shadowing, Marschner may look overly bright because of transmission.
feature.strand_shading.key_feature_2: Enhanced hair glossiness and saturation controls
feature.strand_shading.key_feature_3: Separate specular and diffuse lighting multipliers
feature.strand_shading.key_feature_4: Tangent shift texture support for varied hair highlights
feature.strand_shading.name: Strand Shading
feature.camera_suite.advanced_tooltip_en: Enable Windows HDR instead of forcing it here.
feature.camera_suite.advanced_tooltip_fo: Force enable HDR even without detection (not recommended).
feature.camera_suite.capable_display_win: HDR Capable Display (Windows HDR is off)
Your monitor supports HDR, but Windows HDR is currently disabled.
Enable HDR in Windows Display Settings to allow auto-detection.
feature.camera_suite.description: Real High Dynamic Range output for HDR displays.
feature.camera_suite.display_reports_max: Reported by OS/driver (DXGI MaxLuminance), not a direct meter reading.
It may be EDID metadata and can differ from real highlight peak output.
Treat this as a starting point and tune Peak Brightness as needed.
feature.camera_suite.enable_hdr_tooltip: Enable HDR output. Matches vanilla visuals with extended dynamic range.
feature.camera_suite.enable_hdr_tooltip_: HDR display not detected. Use Advanced button to override.
Monitor supports HDR but Windows HDR is off. Enable HDR in Windows Display Settings, then restart the game.
feature.camera_suite.enabled_without_det: HDR is enabled but no HDR display was detected.
feature.camera_suite.exclusive_fullscree: HDR is not compatible with Exclusive Fullscreen and may not work correctly. Switch to Borderless Windowed mode for proper HDR support.
feature.camera_suite.force_enable_hdr_co: Only proceed if you have an HDR-capable display that was not detected correctly.
feature.camera_suite.force_enable_hdr_de: HDR was not detected on your monitor.
feature.camera_suite.force_enable_hdr_sd: The game will look VERY WRONG on an SDR (standard) display.
feature.camera_suite.key_feature_1: HDR10 output support (10-bit) with upgraded HDR buffers (16-Bit), and fully unclamped rendering pipeline for true HDR values.
feature.camera_suite.key_feature_2: HDR-aware tonemapping based on Skyrim's ISHDR path (Reinhard/Hejl-Burgess-Dawson), preserving the vanilla look while improving highlight handling on HDR displays.
feature.camera_suite.key_feature_3: Configurable paper white and peak brightness.
feature.camera_suite.name: Camera Suite
feature.camera_suite.paper_white_tooltip: How bright SDR white appears on your HDR display.
203 nits is the ITU BT.2408 reference. Increase for a brighter image.
feature.camera_suite.peak_brightness_too: Maximum brightness your display can produce.
Set to match your display's actual peak brightness.
feature.camera_suite.ui_brightness_multi: UI brightness = Paper White x this multiplier in HDR mode.
1.00x = UI renders at Paper White brightness. Higher values make UI brighter relative to scene content.
Note: Main menu and loading screens always render at Paper White brightness.
feature.ambient_probe.dalc_amount_toolti:
Blends the AmbientProbe brightness toward the game's vanilla ambient (DALC) level.
0 = no matching (pure AmbientProbe brightness), 1 = fully matched to vanilla ambient.
feature.ambient_probe.dalc_mode_tooltip:
How the DALC-to-AmbientProbe brightness ratio is computed:
Luminance Ratio: Scalar ratio from overall luminance (loses DALC color tint).
Color Ratio: Per-channel ratio (preserves DALC color tint).
DALC + Sky: Uses vanilla ambient as base, sky AmbientProbe on top. SkyBounce only affects sky.
DALC + Sky (Directional): Same, but SkyBounce also dims vanilla ambient per-direction.
feature.ambient_probe.description: Replaces the game's ambient lighting with physically-based AmbientProbe derived from cubemap spherical harmonics.
feature.ambient_probe.disable_in_loading: Disables AmbientProbe during loading screens and the main menu.
feature.ambient_probe.disable_in_world_m: Disables AmbientProbe while the world map is open.
feature.ambient_probe.enable_ibl_tooltip: Toggle AmbientProbe. When enabled, ambient lighting is derived from cubemap spherical harmonics instead of the vanilla system.
feature.ambient_probe.env_ibl_saturation:
Color saturation of the environment AmbientProbe.
Lower values produce more neutral ambient light; higher values produce more vivid color.
feature.ambient_probe.env_ibl_scale_tool:
Intensity multiplier for the environment AmbientProbe (from World Probes).
Controls how strongly the surrounding environment contributes to ambient lighting.
feature.ambient_probe.fog_mix_tooltip:
Blends the fog color toward the AmbientProbe ambient color.
0 = vanilla fog, 1 = fog fully tinted by AmbientProbe.
feature.ambient_probe.key_feature_1: Projects environment and sky cubemaps into spherical harmonics (SH) for irradiance
feature.ambient_probe.key_feature_2: Dual AmbientProbe sources: environment cubemap (World Probes) and Skyrim's native sky reflections cubemap
feature.ambient_probe.key_feature_3: DALC brightness matching to keep AmbientProbe consistent with the game's ambient light levels
feature.ambient_probe.key_feature_4: Configurable per-source intensity, saturation, fog mixing, and per-weather overrides
feature.ambient_probe.key_feature_5: Static AmbientProbe fallback textures for out-of-world objects (e.g. inventory items)
feature.ambient_probe.name: Ambient Probe
feature.ambient_probe.preserve_fog_lumin:
When Fog Mix is active, rescales the AmbientProbe-tinted fog to keep the original fog brightness.
Prevents fog from becoming too bright or too dark.
feature.ambient_probe.sky_ibl_saturation:
Color saturation of the sky AmbientProbe.
Lower values produce more neutral ambient light; higher values produce more vivid color.
feature.ambient_probe.sky_ibl_scale_tool:
Intensity multiplier for the sky AmbientProbe (from the game's native reflections cubemap).
Controls how strongly the sky contributes to ambient lighting.
feature.ambient_probe.use_static_ibl: Use Stable Lighting Outside the World
feature.ambient_probe.use_static_ibl_too: Uses pre-baked static AmbientProbe cubemap textures for objects rendered outside the game world (e.g. inventory items, loading screens).
feature.interior_daylight.description: Allows for the sun and moon to cast light and shadows into interior spaces.
feature.interior_daylight.force_double_s: Disables backface culling during sun shadowmap rendering in interiors. Will prevent most light leaking through unmasked/unprepared interiors at a small performance cost.
feature.interior_daylight.interior_shado: Sets the distance shadows are rendered at in interiors. Lower values provide higher quality shadows and improved performance but may cause distant interior spaces to light up incorrectly.
feature.interior_daylight.key_feature_1: Functions only for explicitly enabled interiors
feature.interior_daylight.key_feature_2: Utilizes existing sun, moon, and weather systems
feature.interior_daylight.key_feature_3: Includes an option to force double-sided rendering for unprepared interiors
feature.interior_daylight.key_feature_4: Fixes geometry culling issues that cause light leakage
feature.interior_daylight.name: Interior Daylight
feature.natural_lighting.description: Implements an additional inverse square falloff for lighting which allows for a more physically accurate and realistic looking light attenuation.
feature.natural_lighting.key_feature_1: Automatic light radius calculation based on intensity
feature.natural_lighting.key_feature_2: Lights smoothly fade out at a configurable cutoff, solving the infinite distance problem
feature.natural_lighting.key_feature_3: Does not modify any existing lighting
feature.natural_lighting.key_feature_4: Requires the use of mods with lights enabled for inverse square falloff.
feature.natural_lighting.name: Natural Lighting

feature.radiant_grid.description:
Radiant Grid removes the vanilla game's 4-light limit, allowing unlimited dynamic lights in scenes.
This dramatically improves lighting quality and enables more realistic illumination scenarios.
feature.radiant_grid.enable_lights_vis_t: Enables visualization of the light limit
feature.radiant_grid.lights_vis_mode_too:
- Visualise the light limit. Red when the "strict" light limit is reached (portal-strict lights).

 - Visualise the number of clustered lights.
 - Visualize the Shadow Mask.

feature.linear_light_core.description: Linear Light Core does internal color space conversion to improve lighting calculation accuracy.
feature.linear_light_core.name: Linear Light Core
feature.distance_blend.description: Provides seamless visual transitions between Level of Detail (LOD) objects and full-detail objects, eliminating harsh transitions and creating smooth visual continuity.
feature.distance_blend.disable_terrain_v: Disables vertex coloring on nearby terrain. Best combined with terrain LOD generated in xLODGen with Vertex Color Intensity set to 0.
feature.distance_blend.name: Distance Blend
feature.pulse_profiler.post_fg_graph_too:
FSR Frame Generation uses calculated timing data (2x Pre-FG).

feature.pulse_profiler.restore_defaults_: Restores Pulse Profiler settings to defaults, including graphs, appearance, and update intervals.
feature.pulse_profiler.show_in_overlay_t:
Opens performance overlay in a separate window that stays open
even when the main menu is closed.
feature.performance_overlay.description: Real-time performance monitoring system that displays FPS, frame times, draw calls, VRAM usage, and detailed shader performance analysis.
feature.performance_overlay.key_feature_: Real-time FPS and frame time monitoring with configurable update intervals
Interactive draw call analysis with per-shader type performance breakdown
VRAM usage monitoring with visual progress bars
Frame time graphs for pre and post-frame generation analysis
A/B testing support for performance comparison between configurations

feature.hybrid_gi.ao_radius_tooltip: A smaller radius produces tighter AO.
feature.hybrid_gi.depth_fade_range_toolt: Distance range where depth-based effects fade out.
feature.hybrid_gi.description: Screen Space Global Illumination adds realistic indirect lighting and ambient occlusion to the game. This technique simulates how light bounces off surfaces to illuminate other objects naturally.
feature.hybrid_gi.enabled_tooltip: Enable Screen Space Global Illumination. When disabled, all other settings are ignored.
feature.hybrid_gi.geometry_weight_toolti: Higher value makes the blur more sensitive to differences in geometry.
feature.hybrid_gi.hq_specular_il_tooltip: An experimental specular GI that is more accurate but requires more samples. Won't be blurred.
feature.hybrid_gi.il_radius_tooltip: A larger radius produces wider IL.
feature.hybrid_gi.max_frame_accumulation: How many past frames to accumulate results with. Higher values are less noisy but potentially cause ghosting.
feature.hybrid_gi.min_screen_radius_tool: The minimum screen-space effect radius as proportion of display width, to prevent far field AO being too small.
feature.hybrid_gi.movement_disocclusion_:
If a pixel has moved too far from the last frame, its radiance will not be carried to this frame.
Lower values are stricter.
feature.hybrid_gi.name: Radiance Weave
feature.hybrid_gi.slices_tooltip:
How many directions do the samples take.
Controls noise.
feature.hybrid_gi.steps_per_slice_toolti:
How many samples does it take in one direction.
Controls accuracy of lighting, and noise when effect radius is large.
feature.hybrid_gi.thickness_tooltip: How thick the occluders are. Only affects AO.
feature.hybrid_gi.vanilla_ssao_tooltip: Enable Skyrim's built-in SSAO. Usually disabled with Radiance Weave to avoid double-darkening.
feature.contact_shadows.bilinear_thresho: Depth threshold for edge detection during bilinear interpolation. Higher values smooth more aggressively across edges.
feature.contact_shadows.description:
Contact Shadows enhances shadow quality by adding detailed contact shadows and improving shadow accuracy.
This technique adds fine-detail shadows that traditional shadow mapping might miss.
feature.contact_shadows.enable_tooltip: Enable screen-space contact shadows from the sun/moon direction.
feature.contact_shadows.name: Contact Shadows
feature.contact_shadows.sample_count_too: Multiplier for shadow ray sample count. Higher values increase shadow reach at the cost of performance. Adapts to render resolution.
feature.contact_shadows.shadow_contrast_: Contrast boost for the shadow transition. Higher values produce harder shadow edges.
feature.contact_shadows.surface_thicknes: Assumed thickness of surfaces for shadow detection. Lower values produce thinner, more precise shadows.
feature.pixel_capture.async_note: Capture and save run asynchronously without stalling the game.
feature.pixel_capture.folder_tooltip:
Relative paths resolve against the Skyrim install dir.
Absolute paths (e.g. D:\Captures) save there directly.
feature.pixel_capture.hdr_bit_depth_tool: Quantization for the 48 bpp RGB PNG payload. 11-bit is a good default; higher values increase file size with diminishing returns.
feature.pixel_capture.hdr_note: HDR enabled: saves the displayed frame as PNG with HDR10 metadata (48 bpp RGB, cICP/cLLi). Use an HDR-aware viewer such as Windows Photos (HDR on) or Special K SKIF.
feature.pixel_capture.hotkey_collision: This hotkey collides with vanilla PrintScreen; both saves will fire. Set bAllowScreenShot=0 in Skyrim.ini to suppress vanilla, or pick a different hotkey above.
feature.pixel_capture.name: Screenshot
feature.pixel_capture.sdr_note: Enable Camera Suite to capture HDR PNG screenshots with HDR10 metadata. SDR captures use the lossless format selected below.
feature.skin_optics.a_multiplier_for_the: A multiplier for the vanilla specular map, applied to the first layer's roughness
feature.skin_optics.adds_a_constant_laye: Adds a constant layer of wetness to all skin, making it look slightly damp or sweaty at all times, even when not in water or exerting effort.
feature.skin_optics.advanced_skin_shader: PIXL Skin Optics uses balanced dual specular lobes.
feature.skin_optics.controls_how_bumpy_w: Controls how bumpy wet skin appears. Higher values create more visible surface ripples and distortion on wet areas.
feature.skin_optics.controls_how_much_fi: Controls how much fine detail is added to the wetness pattern. Higher values add more small-scale variation on top of the base pattern.
feature.skin_optics.controls_microscopic: Controls microscopic roughness of stratum corneum layer
feature.skin_optics.controls_the_overall: Controls the overall contrast and roughness of the wetness pattern. Higher values make the pattern more pronounced and varied.
feature.skin_optics.controls_the_size_of: Controls the size of the wet/dry pattern on skin. Higher values create a finer, more detailed pattern; lower values produce larger, broader wet patches.
feature.skin_optics.description: Skin Optics gives characters a natural layered response across dry, wet, indoor and outdoor lighting.
feature.skin_optics.extra_roughness_at_t: Extra roughness at the edges of the skin, to approximate peach fuzz on the face.
feature.skin_optics.how_many_seconds_it_: How many seconds it takes for skin to fully dry after leaving water. Higher values mean wetness lingers longer.
feature.skin_optics.key_feature_1: Physically-based dual specular lobes for realistic skin highlights
feature.skin_optics.key_feature_2: Tiled skin detail textures for enhanced realism
feature.skin_optics.key_feature_3: Extra texture support for roughness, translucency, and wetness
feature.skin_optics.key_feature_4: Reworked wetness system for dynamic skin effects
feature.skin_optics.multiplier_for_the_b: Multiplier for the base color texture
feature.skin_optics.multiply_the_tiling_: Multiply the tiling for the body to match the face
feature.skin_optics.name: Skin Optics
feature.skin_optics.options_for_addition: Options for additional roughness and specular maps.
feature.skin_optics.smoothness_of_epider: Smoothness of epidermal cell layer reflections
feature.skin_optics.the_character_reache: The character reaches maximum sweat when stamina drops below this percentage. For example, 0.15 means full sweat below 15%% stamina.
feature.skin_optics.the_character_starts: The character starts sweating when their stamina drops below this percentage. For example, 0.75 means sweat appears below 75%% stamina.
feature.skin_optics.the_more_tiling_the_: The more tiling, the more detailed the skin will be
feature.skin_optics.translucency_of_the_: Translucency of the SSS Transmittance effect
feature.skin_optics.width_of_the_sss_tra: Width of the SSS Transmittance effect
feature.sky_continuity.custom_angle_tool: Set a custom angle for the sun's trajectory.
feature.sky_continuity.description: Synchronizes volumetric lighting and shadows with the actual sun and moon positions in the sky.
feature.sky_continuity.dim_sunlight_unde: Fade directional light to zero as the sun goes below the horizon.
feature.sky_continuity.enabled_tooltip: Enable or disable Sky Continuity features.
feature.sky_continuity.fade_volumetric_l: Also fade volumetric lighting with the directional dim around dawn and dusk.
feature.sky_continuity.horizon_fade_dura: How long (in game hours) the dim eases out after sunset and back in before sunrise.
feature.sky_continuity.key_feature_1: Fixes the mismatch between the positions of the sun and moons and the lighting direction
feature.sky_continuity.key_feature_2: Includes a configurable alternative sun path for more realistic and dramatic lighting
feature.sky_continuity.key_feature_3: Smoothly switches the light source between the sun and moons based on visibility
feature.sky_continuity.key_feature_4: Moon light source can be switched between Masser, Secunda, or the brightest
feature.sky_continuity.key_feature_5: Automatic calculation of moon lighting intensity based on moon phase
feature.sky_continuity.key_feature_6: Fixes the sun appearing higher on the horizon when the player gains altitude
feature.sky_continuity.min_shadow_elevat: The minimum angle sunlight will set to. Caps shadow length. Higher = shorter shadows at sunset/sunrise.
feature.sky_continuity.moon_light_source: Select which moon casts shadows during the night.

feature.sky_continuity.shadow_transition: How long (in game-time units) the shadow direction takes to fade between sources. 100 = ~5 seconds at timescale 20.
feature.sky_continuity.sun_path_tooltip: Choose the trajectory the sun takes across the sky.
feature.sky_continuity.use_alternate_sun: Calculate sun position based on time of day and season instead of vanilla movement.
feature.sky_bounce.description: Simulates realistic ambient lighting by calculating sky occlusion and directional lighting, providing more accurate and natural illumination in outdoor environments.
feature.sky_bounce.key_feature_1: Sky occlusion calculation for ambient lighting
feature.sky_bounce.key_feature_2: Directional skyBounce based on environment geometry
feature.sky_bounce.key_feature_3: Enhanced ambient lighting for outdoor scenes
feature.sky_bounce.key_feature_4: Support for varying sky illumination intensities
feature.sky_bounce.max_zenith_tooltip: Smaller angles creates more focused top-down shadow.
feature.sky_bounce.min_visibility_desc: Minimum visibility values. Diffuse darkens objects. Specular removes the sky from reflections.

menu.advanced.active_shaders_tooltip: List of shaders that have been used in recent frames. Enable Shader Blocking above to use hotkeys to cycle through and block shaders for debugging. Shaders not used for ~1 second are removed from this list.
menu.advanced.avg_parallelism_tooltip_1: Average useful concurrency in this workload.
menu.advanced.avg_parallelism_tooltip_2: Roughly the worker count where adding more cores gives diminishing returns.
menu.advanced.avoid_flow_control_tooltip:
Adds D3DCOMPILE_AVOID_FLOW_CONTROL to the shader compiler flags.
Forces fxc to flatten branches into predicated ops rather than emitting dynamic flow control. Often a win for short branch bodies and uniformly-taken branches; usually a loss for long divergent branches that vanilla flow control would skip entirely.
Resets every launch. Toggling this clears the shader cache and triggers a full recompile.
menu.advanced.background_compiler_thread: Number of threads used to compile shaders during gameplay. Defaults to half of performance cores to avoid impacting the render thread. Higher values finish compilation faster but may cause stuttering.
menu.advanced.clear_shader_cache_tooltip: Clear all compiled shaders from memory. Forces recompilation of all shaders on next use.
menu.advanced.column_frame_pct_tooltip: Percentage of draw calls this frame
menu.advanced.compiler_threads_tooltip: Number of threads used to compile shaders at startup. Defaults to all logical cores minus one for OS headroom (E-cores included). Higher values finish compilation faster but may make the system less responsive.
menu.advanced.compute_tooltip: Replace Compute Shaders. When false, will disable the custom Compute Shaders for the types above. For developers to test whether CS shaders match vanilla behavior.
menu.advanced.copy_info_tooltip: Copy complete shader information including cache path to clipboard
menu.advanced.dump_shaders_tooltip: Dump shaders at startup. This should be used only when reversing shaders. Normal users don't need this.
menu.advanced.enable_file_watcher_toolti: Automatically recompile shaders on file change. Intended for developing.
menu.advanced.enable_shader_blocking_too: Enables hotkeys to cycle through and block individual shaders for debugging purposes.
menu.advanced.frame_annotations_tooltip: Enable detailed frame annotations for debugging render passes and draw calls.
menu.advanced.half_precision_tooltip:
Adds D3DCOMPILE_PARTIAL_PRECISION to the shader compiler flags.
Lets fxc downgrade unmarked float ops to FP16 where it can prove safety, on top of the existing min16float type hints.
On FP16-capable GPUs (Pascal+ / GCN+ / Skylake+) this can halve register pressure and double ALU throughput, but it can also introduce minor visual differences in shaders that haven't been audited for precision sensitivity.
Toggling this clears the shader cache and triggers a full recompile.
menu.advanced.infinite_core_efficiency_t: How close runtime is to the infinite-core lower bound.
menu.advanced.infinite_core_gap_tooltip_: Defined as 100 * (1 - S / T_p). Lower is better.
menu.advanced.log_level_tooltip: Log level. Trace is most verbose. Default is info.
menu.advanced.makespan_tooltip: Observed wall-clock duration for the full shader build.
menu.advanced.parallelism_tooltip_1: Computed lazily from the last completed build.
menu.advanced.parallelism_tooltip_2: Only evaluated when this Statistics section is open.
menu.advanced.pixel_tooltip: Replace Pixel Shaders. When false, will disable the custom Pixel Shaders for the types above. For developers to test whether CS shaders match vanilla behavior.

menu.advanced.press_key_shader_block_pre: Press any key for Shader Block Previous...
menu.advanced.queue_wait_tooltip_1: Time spent waiting in the ready queue before a worker started compilation.
menu.advanced.queue_wait_tooltip_2: Useful for identifying scheduler-induced delay separate from compile cost.
menu.advanced.shader_defines_tooltip: Defines for Shader Compiler. Semicolon ";" separated. Clear with space. Rebuild shaders after making change. Compute Shaders require a restart to recompile.
menu.advanced.span_tooltip_1: Critical-path lower bound, approximated by the single slowest shader.
menu.advanced.span_tooltip_2: Even infinite cores cannot finish faster than this.
menu.advanced.vertex_tooltip: Replace Vertex Shaders. When false, will disable the custom Vertex Shaders for the types above. For developers to test whether CS shaders match vanilla behavior.
menu.advanced.work_metric: Work (W, sum of task wall times): %s
menu.advanced.work_tooltip_1: Total compile work: sum of all per-shader wall-clock compile times.
menu.advanced.work_tooltip_2: This is not CPU time; it is accumulated task elapsed time.
menu.advanced.work_tooltip_3: Equivalent serial time on one worker if overhead stayed the same.
menu.clear_shader_cache_tooltip: Clears the shader cache and disk cache (if enabled). The Shader Cache is the collection of compiled shaders which replace the vanilla shaders at runtime. The Disk Cache is a collection of compiled shaders on disk. Clearing will mean that shaders are recompiled only when the game re-encounters them.
menu.disable_at_boot_desc: Select features to disable at boot. This is the same as deleting a feature.ini file. Restart will be required to reenable.
menu.faq.a1: PIXL Renderer is a complete visual pipeline for Skyrim. Its lighting, materials, atmosphere, water, terrain, characters, and camera are tuned together instead of installed as separate add-ons.
menu.faq.a2: Essentials mode provides a master switch and coordinated quality sliders. Advanced mode exposes every renderer subsystem with detailed tooltips.
menu.faq.a3: Features may fail to load due to hardware incompatibility, missing dependencies, or conflicts with other mods. Check the 'Feature Issues' tab for detailed information about any problematic features.
menu.faq.a4: Failed shaders are usually caused by mixed file versions. Ensure all features are up to date and avoid mixing files from test builds or outdated versions. Please review the 'Feature Issues' tab and/or Wiki for more information. Update your features and remove any obsolete features.
menu.faq.a5: Lower the global graphics-quality slider first. It preserves PIXL's visual balance while reducing resolution and sampling across the expensive systems.
menu.faq.a6: No. PIXL Renderer owns the shader-hook runtime and must not be installed beside another shader-hook renderer.
menu.faq.a7: PIXL Renderer uses END to open the menu by default. Change it under General > Keybindings if needed.
menu.faq.a8: Use Developer tools only when producing diagnostics or shader reports. Normal players should use Essentials or Advanced mode.
menu.faq.a9: PIXL Renderer is GPL-licensed. The package retains the required licence, source terms, and attribution in SOURCE-AND-CREDITS.md.
menu.faq.q3: Why are some features not loading?
